exercises.instructions: Choose the correct present perfect word (ever, never, just, already, yet) for each sentence.

questions.question: I haven't spoken to my mum ___.
questions.explanation: 'Yet' goes at the end of negative sentences to indicate something expected has not happened. 'yet' ကို negative sentences ရဲ့ အဆုံးမှာ ထားပါ။

questions.explanation: 'Already' goes before the past participle to say something happened earlier than expected. 'already' ကို past participle ရဲ့ ရှေ့မှာ ထားပါ။
